**Not ready to publish.** One claim goes beyond what we can back up.

**Claims check**

| Claim in draft | Status |
|---|---|
| "Loose leaf tea" | Product fact, fine |
| "packed by hand in Bristol" / "Every tin is packed by hand in Bristol" | Allowlisted (Operations) |
| "certified organic by the Soil Association" | Allowlisted (certificate renewed 2026) |
| "Free UK delivery on all orders" | **Unsupported.** The policy says free UK delivery on orders **over £25**. "All orders" promises something the shipping policy doesn't. |

**Other notes**
- The first two sentences say the same thing (packed by hand in Bristol). This isn't a compliance problem, but the copy is tighter if you keep one.
- No banned words, superlatives, guarantees, health or green claims, or fake urgency.
- No disclosure label is needed, since this is our own landing page.

**Suggested version**

> Loose leaf tea, packed by hand in Bristol. Certified organic by the Soil Association. Free UK delivery on orders over £25.

Sam still needs to approve it, as for all public content.
